Readings

The readings for the class come primarily from the instructor’s own text: Sussman, Joseph. Perspectives on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS). New York, NY: Springer, 2005. ISBN: 0387232575. Along with the sections listed by session, you should be sure to read the following sections as general reference: III.1, III.2, IV.2, IV.6, IV.10. Additional readings for each class are also provided.
